files.name: recommendation.json
files.note: Top-level must be a JSON array of exactly 5 recipe objects, OR a JSON object whose array lives under one of root_wrapper_keys. No CSV variant exists.

fields.name: 半成品名称
fields.note: Product label. HALF_PRODUCT_TARGET=None so any value — or no value — is accepted. Hard-rejected only if known_products is non-empty, which it never is (oracle returns []). First matching key wins; if none present, stored as null.

fields.name: 原材料用量
fields.note: Maps material name to KG usage. Values must be float-castable, finite, and non-negative; violating entries are skipped with a warning. Material names not in the oracle's known set are dropped with a warning (not a hard fail). The dict must be non-empty after filtering. These quantities are the agent's core answer — any change alters the scoring. 单位换算：源数据里若某原料带单位（客户原始 BOM 表有「数量 / 单位」两列，抗泡剂一类按 ML 计），必须先换成 KG 再填——evaluator 的 _oracle_bom_kg 用的是 unit=="ML" → 0.0485 KG 这个固定当量（不按数量比例折算）。原样保留 "50.0 ML" 这样的带单位字符串会 float() 失败、该条被静默丢弃，配方少一味添加剂，分数出现 1e-4 量级的无谓漂移（实测两个抽取器就差在这一处）。

fields.name: rank
fields.note: Not read by the evaluator at all; the evaluator generates rank as i+1 from list position. May be present and is silently ignored.

structural_checks: top-level must resolve to a list (bare JSON array, or via root_wrapper_keys lookup on a dict)
list must contain exactly 5 recipe objects (N_RECOMMENDATIONS = 5)
each element must be a JSON object — null, array, or scalar triggers a normalization failure
each recipe's 原材料用量 (or accepted alias) must be a non-empty dict after unknown-material filtering
per-recipe sum of all material KG must be in [200.0, 2000.0]
light-grade base oil fraction (LIGHT_OILS = {M020, M022, M041, M049, M053}) must be in [16.0%, 29.0%] of total mass
heavy-grade base oil fraction (HEAVY_OILS = {M016, M035, M038, M039, M048, M051}) must be in [2.0%, 14.0%] of total mass
single base oil fraction must be ≤ 63.0% of total mass
each recipe must contain exactly 1 复合剂 (DI package) from {M054, M058, M059, M060, M061, M062}
复合剂 dose fraction must be within ±1.5 pp of its locked treat rate (B=6.88%, F=7.58%, G=8.30%, H=7.89%, I=9.40%, J=7.68%)
